objectives.description: Apply the shared per-phase procedure to the 19 declared files

objectives.description: cslib's hard-mode and PR-review skills: check against the live [PR READY] lifecycle rather than renaming mechanically
objectives.note: Verified against CLAUDE.md's documented [PR READY] lifecycle and the live cslib README's own routing tables before rewording: for task_type=pr, the research and implement PHASES (dispatched identically to any other task_type, via /orchestrate) route to pr-specific skills (skill-pr-review-research/skill-pr-review-implementation vs. the pr-submission-only skill-pr-implementation) based on whether a `sources` array is present -- this routing distinction is orthogonal to the dead-command naming and was preserved exactly; only the command tokens naming the phases were reworded ('/research N' -> 'a research-phase dispatch for N', etc.), never the pr-submission-vs-pr-review branching logic itself.

objectives.description: memory/README.md (densest file, 8 occurrences measured) -- the --clean suppression claim must stay true after rewording
objectives.note: Verified via commands/orchestrate.md (`--clean` | Skip automatic memory retrieval) and skill-orchestrate/SKILL.md's `clean_flag` wiring that `--clean` IS a live, currently-supported `/orchestrate` flag before rewording the suppression example to `/orchestrate N --research --clean` -- the claim remains true, not merely reworded. The matching EXTENSION.md and skill-learn/README.md copies of the same auto-retrieval/--clean prose (EXTENSION.md is literally merged into the generated root CLAUDE.md, same mechanism Phase 13 will check for literature's merge-sources/claudemd.md) were reworded identically for consistency.

objectives.description: Residue discovered and recorded, not fixed: the `--remember` flag named in memory-setup.md and memory-troubleshooting.md appears nowhere else in the system
objectives.note: grep-confirmed `--remember` is not a flag recognized by orchestrate.md, skill-orchestrate/SKILL.md, or manifest.json anywhere in the corpus -- it appears to be a vestigial explicit opt-in flag from before auto-retrieval existed (skill-learn/README.md's own prose says 'No explicit opt-in flag is needed' for the CURRENT behavior). This is a separate, pre-existing defect class from the dead-command naming this task owns. The dead-command token in each occurrence was reworded ('/research' -> '/orchestrate --research') while `--remember` was left exactly as-is; named here as residue for a follow-up record, same treatment as other out-of-scope findings across this task.
